authorization: User explicitly requests fresh native BAGEL + DepGraph-U without TaylorSeer; small component control. Prior definition includes attributed FlashU-style FFN policy where applicable.

arms.native: Full original FFN; CADD off; native KV; TaylorSeer off
arms.rewrite_only: Full original FFN; output-dependent native dispatch elides unused image-CFG prompt producer/metadata; no Taylor provider; native live KV preserved
arms.policy_only: Fixed attributed Wanda/FlashU-style generation FFN pruning; CADD off; TaylorSeer off
arms.depgraphu: Same fixed inherited FFN policy + native output-dependent dead-CFG producer dispatch; TaylorSeer off

interpretation: native versus depgraphu is the requested assembled system without TaylorSeer; rewrite_only/native and depgraphu/policy_only isolate added execution dispatch. Fixed FFN pruning is inherited, approximate, not claimed new.
non_applicable: BAGEL has no Show-o2 Head-A/B split. Vocab projection is already absent and native KV retained. DLS/Taylor/last-layer-history optimization off. Existing Taylor-CADD fast-return branch gets no hits; native CFG producer pruning is measured separately.
sampling: 2 prompts per GenEval category, predetermined SHA256 ranking of dgu-notaylor-v1|index|prompt; no score consultation
order: Four cyclic Latin-square rotations, round offset; every arm occupies each position 3 times per repeat
calibration: same two synthetic disjoint prompts, native full generation, seeds600/601, separately repeated and retained-index hashes checked across processes
correctness: Two synthetic prompts x4 arms, same-policy velocity/x_t/initial-noise/live-prefix-KV/RNG/pixel equality; unused image-CFG state deliberately not preserved. Check text prefills2->1 and CFG metadata2->1;49flowsteps and0vocab. Guard fallback unit checks. Separate warmups and no trace/hooks in formal timing.
taylor_exclusion: Pass enable_taylorseer=False explicitly; all Taylor entry functions patched to fail closed; assert model/layer flags false before and after all calls. Set last-layer-history optimization flag false.
timing: CUDA-synchronized wall time from prompt processing through VAE decode, excludes hashes/hooks/image writes/loading/calibration; all arms native prefix KV unchanged; retain per-call timing and peak memory
quality: After all144 formal generations, score12 images per arm from first repeat independently; require exact cross-repeat image hashes before reusing r0 scores. Small diagnostic subset, NOT full GenEval or leaderboard result.
stop_conditions: Source/weight/GPU identity/correctness/Taylor-entry failure; never stop or select on favorable speed or quality. Preserve all failures.
scope: No full553 rerun, no prior results overwritten, no table/manuscript edit, no periodic app polling.
prior_unlaunched_version: v1 disabled Taylor-only CADD, never launched; preserved. v2 includes native dead-CFG producer dispatch found before any new measurements.
native_dispatch: For stateless text-only generation with cfg_img_scale exactly1, text CFG>1 and no think/understanding/image/history input: omit the unused image-CFG context prefill and associated latent metadata. All unsupported requests delegate unchanged. No new approximate caching; this is a BAGEL-specific application of the dependency-liveness rule.
